translation_uz: Muammoni hal qilish bilan shug‘ullanmoq, masalani ko‘rib chiqmoq
definition_en: More formal and precise than 'deal with a problem'; standard academic register for IELTS Writing Task 2.
basic_example_en: Governments should deal with this problem.
example_en: Governments should address this issue through targeted legislation.
example_uz: Hukumatlar ushbu masalani maqsadli qonunchilik orqali hal qilishlari kerak.
example_ru: Правительствам следует заняться решением этого вопроса посредством целевого законодательства.
quiz_question_uz: IELTS Writing Task 2 da «Deal with a problem» o‘rniga ishlatiladigan rasmiy va tabiiy muqobilni toping:
quiz_question_ru: Выберите академическую замену выражению «Deal with a problem» для IELTS Writing Task 2:
quiz_question_en: Which formal IELTS Writing Task 2 expression best upgrades "deal with a problem"?

definition_en: More formal than 'help'; specifically refers to making a process or action easier or more achievable (takes a process/action as object, not a person).
basic_example_en: Modern technology helps international trade.
example_en: Modern digital platforms facilitate seamless international trade.
example_uz: Zamonaviy raqamli platformalar uzluksiz xalqaro savdoni yengillashtiradi.
example_ru: Современные цифровые платформы способствуют бесперебойной международной торговле.
quiz_question_uz: Jarayonni yengillashtirish ma'nosida «help» fe'lining rasmiy IELTS Writing muqobilini tanlang:
quiz_question_ru: Какой глагол уровня C1 заменяет «help», когда речь идёт об облегчении процесса?
quiz_question_en: Which C1 verb formally upgrades "help" when describing making a process easier?

definition_en: Replaces informal 'bad effect' with an authoritative academic noun phrase ideal for cause-and-effect essays.
basic_example_en: Fast food has a bad effect on public health.
example_en: Excessive consumption of ultra-processed food has a detrimental impact on public health.
example_uz: Qayta ishlangan mahsulotlarni haddan ortiq iste'mol qilish jamoat salomatligiga salbiy ta'sir ko‘rsatadi.
example_ru: Чрезмерное потребление ультрапереработанных продуктов оказывает пагубное влияние на общественное здоровье.
quiz_question_uz: «Bad effect» (yomon ta'sir) birikmasining IELTS Writing uchun eng mos C1 muqobili qaysi?
quiz_question_ru: Какое выражение уровня C1 лучше всего заменяет простое «bad effect» в эссе IELTS?
quiz_question_en: Which C1 academic phrase best upgrades the everyday phrase "bad effect"?

translation_uz: Mening fikrimcha / Men shunday dalil keltirgan bo‘lardimki
translation_ru: Я бы сказал(а), что / По моему убеждению
definition_en: Upgrades repetitive 'I think' into a measured, persuasive discourse marker that signals a reasoned opinion in Speaking Part 3 and Writing Task 2.
basic_example_en: I think university education should be free for everyone.
example_en: I would argue that higher education should be accessible to all qualified students.
example_uz: Men oliy ta'lim barcha malakali talabalar uchun ochiq bo‘lishi kerak deb hisoblayman.
example_ru: Я бы сказал, что высшее образование должно быть доступным для всех квалифицированных студентов.
quiz_question_uz: IELTS Speaking Part 3 va Writing da «I think» o‘rniga fikrni asoslab aytish uchun qaysi ibora mos?
quiz_question_ru: Какая фраза уровня B2–C1 естественно заменяет «I think» при аргументации мнения в IELTS?
quiz_question_en: Which B2–C1 discourse phrase upgrades "I think" when presenting a reasoned argument?

definition_en: Formal academic verb used with negative nouns (problems, tensions, shortages); much more concise and formal than 'make worse'.
basic_example_en: Rising fuel prices made the economic crisis worse.
example_en: The sudden hike in fuel prices only exacerbated the economic crisis.
example_uz: Yoqilg‘i narxlarining keskin oshishi iqtisodiy inqirozni yanada og‘irlashtirdi.
example_ru: Резкое повышение цен на топливо лишь усугубило экономический кризис.
quiz_question_uz: «Make worse» (vaziyatni yanada yomonlashtirmoq) ma'nosidagi akademik fe'lni tanlang:
quiz_question_ru: Какой академический глагол заменяет «make worse» (усугублять проблему)?
quiz_question_en: Which formal academic verb best upgrades "make worse"?

definition_en: Formal academic verb meaning to make something harmful or unpleasant less severe; collocates strongly with 'risks', 'effects', 'damage'.
basic_example_en: Planting trees helps reduce the negative effects of air pollution.
example_en: Expanding urban green spaces helps mitigate the adverse effects of air pollution.
example_uz: Shahardagi yashil hududlarni kengaytirish havo ifloslanishining salbiy oqibatlarini kamaytirishga yordam beradi.
example_ru: Расширение городских зелёных зон помогает смягчить негативные последствия загрязнения воздуха.
quiz_question_uz: «Reduce negative effects» (zarar yoki xavfni kamaytirmoq) ma'nosidagi C1 akademik fe'lni toping:
quiz_question_ru: Какой глагол уровня C1 означает «смягчать, снижать негативные последствия»?
quiz_question_en: Which C1 academic verb means to reduce the severity of negative effects or risks?

definition_en: Upgrades the overused 'play an important role' into a high-scoring C1 collocation emphasizing central importance.
basic_example_en: Parents play an important role in a child's early development.
example_en: Parents play a pivotal role in shaping a child's early cognitive development.
example_uz: Ota-onalar bolaning ilk aqliy rivojlanishini shakllantirishda hal qiluvchi rol o‘ynaydi.
example_ru: Родители играют ключевую роль в формировании раннего когнитивного развития ребёнка.
quiz_question_uz: IELTS insholarida ko‘p takrorlanadigan «Play an important role» o‘rniga qaysi C1 collocation ishlatiladi?
quiz_question_ru: Какая коллокация уровня C1 лучше всего заменяет шаблонное «play an important role»?
quiz_question_en: Which C1 collocation upgrades the overused phrase "play an important role"?

definition_en: More specific than 'a serious problem'; conveys urgency and the need for immediate attention in IELTS essays and discussions.
basic_example_en: Youth unemployment is a serious problem in many countries.
example_en: Youth unemployment remains a pressing issue across many developing economies.
example_uz: Yoshlar ishsizligi ko‘plab rivojlanayotgan davlatlarda dolzarb masala bo‘lib qolmoqda.
example_ru: Молодёжная безработица остаётся насущной проблемой во многих развивающихся странах.
quiz_question_uz: «A serious problem» (jiddiy va shoshilinch muammo) birikmasining tabiiy IELTS muqobilini toping:
quiz_question_ru: Какая коллокация уровня B2–C1 заменяет «a serious problem», подчёркивая актуальность вопроса?
quiz_question_en: Which natural B2–C1 collocation upgrades "a serious problem" that requires urgent attention?

definition_en: Natural idiomatic phrasal verb preferred in IELTS Speaking over the more formal Latinate 'postpone'.
basic_example_en: Many people postpone visiting the dentist until they feel pain.
example_en: Many people tend to put off visiting the dentist until the pain becomes unbearable.
example_uz: Ko‘pchilik og‘riq chidab bo‘lmas darajaga yetmaguncha tish shifokoriga borishni keyinga qoldiradi.
example_ru: Многие люди склонны откладывать визит к стоматологу до тех пор, пока боль не станет невыносимой.
quiz_question_uz: IELTS Speaking da «postpone» (keyinga qoldirmoq) o‘rniga tabiiy eshitiladigan phrasal verb qaysi?
quiz_question_ru: Какой фразовый глагол естественно заменяет «postpone» (откладывать) в устной речи IELTS Speaking?
quiz_question_en: Which natural phrasal verb replaces "postpone" in IELTS Speaking?

definition_en: More natural in IELTS Speaking than 'encounter' when describing finding information, objects, or unexpected situations by chance.
basic_example_en: I encountered an interesting article about space travel yesterday.
example_en: I came across a fascinating article about space exploration while browsing yesterday.
example_uz: Kecha internet ko‘rib o‘tirib, fazoni tadqiq qilish haqidagi qiziqarli maqolaga duch keldim.
example_ru: Вчера я случайно наткнулся на увлекательную статью об исследовании космоса.
quiz_question_uz: «Tasodifan duch kelmoq / uchratib qolmoq» ma'nosida IELTS Speaking uchun eng tabiiy phrasal verb qaysi?
quiz_question_ru: Какой фразовый глагол означает «случайно наткнуться на что-либо» в IELTS Speaking?
quiz_question_en: Which phrasal verb naturally expresses encountering or finding something by chance in IELTS Speaking?

definition_en: Replaces informal 'a lot of' before uncountable nouns (time, money, effort, research) in formal IELTS Writing.
basic_example_en: The government spent a lot of money on new roads.
example_en: The municipality invested a considerable amount of funding in public transit.
example_uz: Shahar hokimiyati jamoat transportiga sezilarli miqdorda mablag‘ yo‘naltirdi.
example_ru: Муниципалитет вложил значительный объём средств в общественный транспорт.
quiz_question_uz: Sanalmaydigan otlar oldidan «a lot of» o‘rniga IELTS Writing da qaysi rasmiy birikma ishlatiladi?
quiz_question_ru: Какое формальное выражение заменяет «a lot of» перед неисчисляемыми существительными в IELTS Writing?
quiz_question_en: Which formal quantifier phrase best upgrades "a lot of" before uncountable nouns in IELTS Writing?

translation_uz: O‘ta muhim, hal qiluvchi ahamiyatga ega
definition_en: Stronger and more precise than 'important'; indicates that success or failure depends on something.
basic_example_en: Time management is important for university students.
example_en: Effective time management is crucial for academic success at university.
example_uz: Vaqtni samarali boshqarish universitetdagi akademik muvaffaqiyat uchun o‘ta muhimdir.
example_ru: Эффективное управление временем критически важно для академического успеха в университете.
quiz_question_uz: Oddiy «important» sifatini kuchliroq va aniqroq ifodalovchi B2–C1 so‘zni toping:
quiz_question_ru: Какое прилагательное уровня B2–C1 усиливает и заменяет простое слово «important»?
quiz_question_en: Which B2–C1 adjective provides a stronger, more precise upgrade for "important"?

definition_en: More constructive and nuanced than 'problem'; frames a difficulty as something demanding effort and skill to overcome.
basic_example_en: Adapting to a new culture is a big problem for international students.
example_en: Adapting to an unfamiliar culture presents a significant challenge for international students.
example_uz: Notanish madaniyatga moslashish xorijlik talabalar uchun jiddiy sinov hisoblanadi.
example_ru: Адаптация к незнакомой культуре представляет собой серьёзный вызов для иностранных студентов.
quiz_question_uz: IELTS da «problem» so‘zini yanada konstruktiv va akademik ohangda qaysi so‘z bilan almashtirish mumkin?
quiz_question_ru: Какое слово конструктивно заменяет «problem», обозначая сложную задачу, требующую усилий?
quiz_question_en: Which constructive noun upgrades "problem" when describing a demanding situation?

definition_en: More formal than 'enough'; used before nouns in academic writing to mean satisfactory in quantity or quality.
basic_example_en: Many rural schools do not have enough funding.
example_en: Many rural schools lack adequate financial resources.
example_uz: Ko‘plab qishloq maktablarida yetarli moliyaviy resurslar mavjud emas.
example_ru: Многим сельским школам не хватает достаточных финансовых ресурсов.
quiz_question_uz: IELTS Writing da «enough» (yetarli) so‘zining rasmiy sifat shakli qaysi?
quiz_question_ru: Какое формальное прилагательное заменяет «enough» в академическом письме IELTS?
quiz_question_en: Which formal adjective upgrades "enough" in IELTS Writing Task 2?

translation_uz: Sinchkovlik bilan tekshirmoq, mukammal ko‘zdan kechirmoq
definition_en: Academic verb meaning to examine critically down to the smallest detail; far more concise than 'examine very carefully'.
basic_example_en: Researchers examined the data very carefully before publishing.
example_en: Researchers scrutinized the clinical data before publishing their findings.
example_uz: Tadqiqotchilar o‘z xulosalarini chop etishdan oldin klinik ma'lumotlarni sinchkovlik bilan tekshirdilar.
example_ru: Исследователи тщательно проверили клинические данные перед публикацией результатов.
quiz_question_uz: «Examine very carefully» (har bir detaligacha sinchiklab tekshirmoq) ma'nosidagi C1 fe'l qaysi?
quiz_question_ru: Какой глагол уровня C1 заменяет «examine very carefully»?
quiz_question_en: Which C1 academic verb means to examine or inspect critically in fine detail?

definition_en: High-level academic verb meaning to make a complex concept clear and lucid.
basic_example_en: The professor explained the theory clearly with examples.
example_en: The professor used real-world case studies to elucidate the economic theory.
example_uz: Professor iqtisodiy nazariyani oydinlashtirib tushuntirish uchun hayotiy misollardan foydalandi.
example_ru: Профессор использовал реальные примеры, чтобы разъяснить экономическую теорию.
quiz_question_uz: Murakkab mavzuni oydinlashtirib, ravshan tushuntirib berish ma'nosidagi akademik fe'lni toping:
quiz_question_ru: Какой академический глагол означает «прояснять, подробно разъяснять сложный вопрос»?
quiz_question_en: Which academic verb upgrades "explain clearly" when clarifying a complex topic?

translation_ru: Разобраться с чем-либо, всерьёз взяться за проблему
definition_en: Idiomatic C1 collocation used in both Speaking Part 3 and Writing to describe tackling a complex difficulty.
basic_example_en: The government still hasn't understood and dealt with inflation.
example_en: The government still hasn't got to grips with the underlying causes of inflation.
example_uz: Hukumat hali ham inflyatsiyaning tub sabablarini tushunib, hal qilishga kirishgani yo‘q.
example_ru: Правительство до сих пор не разобралось с глубинными причинами инфляции.
quiz_question_uz: Muammoni chuqur tushunib, uni hal qilishga kirishish ma'nosidagi C1 iborani toping:
quiz_question_ru: Какое выражение уровня C1 означает «всерьёз разобраться с трудной проблемой»?
quiz_question_en: Which C1 expression means to begin to understand and deal with a difficult problem?

definition_en: Formal collocation used with 'plans', 'efforts', or 'projects' when they finally produce intended results.
basic_example_en: After years of work, their research project finally succeeded as planned.
example_en: Years of painstaking research finally came to fruition when the treatment was approved.
example_uz: Ko‘p yillik mashaqqatli tadqiqotlar davolash usuli tasdiqlanganda nihoyat o‘z mevasini berdi.
example_ru: Годы кропотливых исследований наконец принесли плоды, когда метод лечения был одобрен.
quiz_question_uz: Reja yoki loyihaning muvaffaqiyatli amalga oshib, natija berishini qaysi birikma ifodalaydi?
quiz_question_ru: Какое выражение означает «воплотиться в жизнь, принести ожидаемые плоды»?
quiz_question_en: Which expression describes a long-term plan finally producing its intended results?

translation_ru: Всерьёз взяться за дело, засучить рукава
definition_en: Natural phrasal verb for IELTS Speaking when talking about studying or preparing for exams with determination.
basic_example_en: With exams coming soon, I need to start working hard.
example_en: With final exams just three weeks away, I had to buckle down and revise every module.
example_uz: Yakuniy imtihonlargacha atigi uch hafta qolganida, yeng shimarib har bir modulni takrorlashimga to‘g‘ri keldi.
example_ru: Когда до экзаменов осталось всего три недели, мне пришлось всерьёз взяться за учёбу и повторить каждый модуль.
quiz_question_uz: Chalg‘imasdan, bor e'tibor bilan qattiq o‘qish yoki mehnatga kirishish qaysi phrasal verb bilan aytiladi?
quiz_question_ru: Какой фразовый глагол уровня C1 означает «засучить рукава и усердно взяться за учёбу»?
quiz_question_en: Which C1 phrasal verb means to start working or studying diligently with full focus?

definition_en: Expressive C1–C2 phrasal verb describing how something's value, size, or strength is eroded step by step.
basic_example_en: High inflation has gradually reduced people's savings.
example_en: High inflation has steadily whittled away households' purchasing power.
example_uz: Yuqori inflyatsiya oilalarning xarid qobiliyatini asta-sekin yemirib bordi.
example_ru: Высокая инфляция постепенно свела на нет покупательную способность домохозяйств.
quiz_question_uz: Biror narsaning qiymati yoki hajmini asta-sekin kamaytirish qaysi phrasal verb bilan aytiladi?
quiz_question_ru: Какой фразовый глагол означает «постепенно урезать, сводить на нет»?
quiz_question_en: Which phrasal verb means to gradually erode or reduce the size or strength of something?

translation_ru: Всё больше и больше, во всё большей степени
definition_en: Replaces conversational 'more and more' with a single concise academic adverb suited for IELTS Writing Task 1 & 2.
basic_example_en: People are relying on smartphones more and more.
example_en: Consumers are increasingly relying on mobile applications for daily banking.
example_uz: Iste'molchilar kundalik bank xizmatlari uchun mobil ilovalarga tobora ko‘proq tayanmoqdalar.
example_ru: Потребители всё больше полагаются на мобильные приложения для повседневных банковских операций.
quiz_question_uz: Og‘zaki nutqdagi «more and more» birikmasini IELTS Writing da qaysi ravish bilan almashtirish kerak?
quiz_question_ru: Какое академическое наречие заменяет разговорное «more and more» в IELTS Writing?
quiz_question_en: Which single academic adverb upgrades the conversational phrase "more and more"?

definition_en: Upgrades basic 'good for' into formal academic register for IELTS essays discussing advantages and positive effects.
basic_example_en: Regular exercise is good for mental health.
example_en: Regular physical activity is highly beneficial to both physical and mental well-being.
example_uz: Muntazam jismoniy faollik ham jismoniy, ham ruhiy salomatlik uchun juda foydalidir.
example_ru: Регулярная физическая активность весьма полезна как для физического, так и для психического благополучия.
quiz_question_uz: IELTS Writing da oddiy «good for» o‘rniga qaysi rasmiy birikma ishlatiladi?
quiz_question_ru: Какое формальное выражение заменяет простое «good for» в эссе IELTS?
quiz_question_en: Which formal adjective phrase upgrades "good for" in IELTS Writing Task 2?

definition_en: Upgrades simple 'because of' into an academic passive structure ('can be attributed to') ideal for analyzing causes in Task 1 and Task 2.
basic_example_en: Longevity has increased because of better healthcare.
example_en: The rise in life expectancy can be largely attributed to advances in preventive medicine.
example_uz: Umr ko‘rish davomiyligining oshishi asosan profilaktik tibbiyotdagi yutuqlar bilan izohlanadi.
example_ru: Рост продолжительности жизни во многом объясняется достижениями профилактической медицины.
quiz_question_uz: Sababni tahlil qilishda «because of» o‘rniga «can be ...» qurilmasida qaysi C1 ibora ishlatiladi?
quiz_question_ru: Какое выражение уровня C1 используется в конструкции «can be ...» вместо простого «because of»?
quiz_question_en: Which C1 academic phrase upgrades "because of" in cause-and-effect sentences ("can be ___")?

translation_ru: Коренным образом изменить, произвести революцию в
definition_en: Strong, precise verb meaning to transform a field, industry, or system completely and positively.
basic_example_en: The internet has completely changed how people communicate.
example_en: High-speed internet has revolutionized the way global teams collaborate.
example_uz: Yuqori tezlikdagi internet global jamoalarning hamkorlik qilish usulini tubdan o‘zgartirib yubordi.
example_ru: Высокоскоростной интернет коренным образом изменил способы сотрудничества глобальных команд.
quiz_question_uz: Soha yoki tizimni «change completely» (tubdan o‘zgartirmoq) ma'nosidagi C1 fe'lni toping:
quiz_question_ru: Какой глагол уровня C1 заменяет «change completely» в контексте технологий и общества?
quiz_question_en: Which C1 verb upgrades "change completely" when describing transformative innovations?

translation_uz: Boshchilik qilmoq, ilg‘or tashabbusning oldingi safida bo‘lmoq
definition_en: Dynamic C1–C2 verb meaning to serve as the leader or driving force of an initiative or reform.
basic_example_en: Dr. Karimova was chosen to lead the new digital education project.
example_en: Dr. Karimova was appointed to spearhead the national digital literacy initiative.
example_uz: Doktor Karimova milliy raqamli savodxonlik tashabbusiga boshchilik qilish uchun tayinlandi.
example_ru: Доктор Каримова была назначена возглавить национальную инициативу цифровой грамотности.
quiz_question_uz: Muhim islohot yoki yirik loyihaning boshida turib yetakchilik qilish qaysi fe'l bilan ifodalanadi?
quiz_question_ru: Какой глагол означает «возглавить важное начинание или реформу»?
quiz_question_en: Which verb upgrades "lead an important project or reform"?

translation_uz: Qisqa va lo‘nda ifodalamoq, asosiy mohiyatini mujassam etmoq
translation_ru: Вкратце выразить суть, воплотить в себе главное
definition_en: Formal verb meaning to express the most essential features of an idea or trend concisely.
basic_example_en: The speaker summarized the economic forecast briefly in three slides.
example_en: The keynote speaker encapsulated the complex economic forecast in three slides.
example_uz: Asosiy ma'ruzachi murakkab iqtisodiy prognozni uchta slaydda qisqa va lo‘nda ifodalab berdi.
example_ru: Ключевой докладчик лаконично выразил суть сложного экономического прогноза в трёх слайдах.
quiz_question_uz: Murakkab g‘oyaning butun mohiyatini qisqa va aniq mujassam etish qaysi C1 fe'l bilan aytiladi?
quiz_question_ru: Какой глагол уровня C1 означает «лаконично передать самую суть чего-либо»?
quiz_question_en: Which C1 verb means to capture and express the essential features of something concisely?

translation_uz: Qadriga yetmaslik, o‘z-o‘zidan bo‘ladigandek qabul qilmoq
definition_en: Natural B2–C1 collocation suitable for both IELTS Speaking and Writing Task 2 when discussing modern conveniences or privileges.
basic_example_en: We often fail to appreciate clean drinking water until a crisis happens.
example_en: We often take clean drinking water for granted until a crisis strikes.
example_uz: Biz ko‘pincha inqiroz yuz bermaguncha toza ichimlik suvini o‘z-o‘zidan bo‘ladigandek qabul qilamiz.
example_ru: Мы часто воспринимаем чистую питьевую воду как должное, пока не грянет кризис.
quiz_question_uz: Biror ne'matning qadriga yetmay, o‘z-o‘zidan bo‘ladigandek qabul qilish qaysi ibora bilan aytiladi?
quiz_question_ru: Какое выражение означает «воспринимать как должное, не ценить»?
quiz_question_en: Which expression means to fail to appreciate the value of something familiar?

translation_uz: Kutilganidan ham ko‘proq harakat qilmoq, jon kuydirmoq
translation_ru: Приложить максимум усилий, сделать больше требуемого
definition_en: High-scoring idiomatic collocation for IELTS Speaking Part 2 & 3 when describing dedication, service, or work ethic.
basic_example_en: She always tries much harder than expected to satisfy her clients.
example_en: She always goes the extra mile to ensure her clients are completely satisfied.
example_uz: U mijozlari to‘liq mamnun bo‘lishini ta'minlash uchun doimo kutilganidan ham ko‘proq harakat qiladi.
example_ru: Она всегда делает больше требуемого, чтобы её клиенты остались полностью довольны.
quiz_question_uz: «Kutilganidan ham ko‘proq harakat qilmoq» ma'nosini beruvchi C1 iborani toping:
quiz_question_ru: Выберите выражение уровня C1 со значением «приложить особые усилия, сделать больше ожидаемого»:
quiz_question_en: Which C1 expression means to make a special effort beyond what is required?

translation_ru: Происходить из, корениться в, быть вызванным
definition_en: High-utility C1 phrasal verb used in both IELTS Writing Task 2 and Speaking Part 3 to explain the root cause of a phenomenon.
basic_example_en: Many health problems are caused by a sedentary lifestyle.
example_en: Many chronic health conditions stem from an increasingly sedentary lifestyle.
example_uz: Ko‘plab surunkali salomatlik muammolari tobora kamharakat turmush tarzidan kelib chiqadi.
example_ru: Многие хронические заболевания коренятся во всё более малоподвижном образе жизни.
quiz_question_uz: Muammoning tub sababi «...dan kelib chiqmoq» ekanini bildiruvchi C1 phrasal verb qaysi?
quiz_question_ru: Какой фразовый глагол уровня C1 означает «корениться в, происходить по причине»?
quiz_question_en: Which C1 phrasal verb upgrades "be caused by" when identifying the root origin of an issue?

translation_uz: Keltirib chiqarmoq, ro‘yobga chiqarmoq (ijobiy o‘zgarish yoki islohotni)
definition_en: Natural C1 phrasal verb frequently used in IELTS essays and speaking to describe causing significant social or technological changes.
basic_example_en: Renewable energy will cause major changes in the power sector.
example_en: Solar innovation has brought about a profound transformation in the energy sector.
example_uz: Quyosh energetikasidagi yangiliklar energetika sohasida chuqur o‘zgarishlarni keltirib chiqardi.
example_ru: Инновации в солнечной энергетике привели к глубокой трансформации энергетического сектора.
quiz_question_uz: Katta o‘zgarish yoki natijani «cause to happen» (amalga oshirmoq / keltirib chiqarmoq) ma'nosidagi phrasal verb qaysi?
quiz_question_ru: Какой фразовый глагол означает «вызвать, привести к серьёзным переменам»?
quiz_question_en: Which phrasal verb upgrades "cause to happen" when discussing social or technological change?

simple_word: Stop something from growing or developing
definition_en: Concise formal verb replacing 'stop from growing or developing'; commonly used in IELTS Writing Task 2.
basic_example_en: Poor infrastructure stops economic growth in rural areas.
example_en: Inadequate transport infrastructure continues to hinder economic growth in remote regions.
example_uz: Transport infratuzilmasining yetarli emasligi chekka hududlarda iqtisodiy o‘sishga to‘sqinlik qilishda davom etmoqda.
example_ru: Недостаточно развитая транспортная инфраструктура продолжает препятствовать экономическому росту в отдалённых регионах.
quiz_question_uz: Rivojlanish yoki jarayonga to‘sqinlik qilish ma'nosidagi rasmiy IELTS fe'lini toping:
quiz_question_ru: Какой формальный глагол означает «препятствовать, тормозить развитие»?
quiz_question_en: Which formal B2–C1 verb upgrades "make it difficult for something to develop or succeed"?

translation_uz: Rivojlantirmoq, shakllanishiga va o‘sishiga sharoit yaratmoq
definition_en: High-scoring IELTS verb used with abstract nouns ('creativity', 'cooperation', 'innovation') instead of 'encourage the development of'.
basic_example_en: Schools should encourage the development of critical thinking.
example_en: Modern curricula should foster critical thinking and independent inquiry.
example_uz: Zamonaviy o‘quv dasturlari tanqidiy fikrlash va mustaqil izlanishni rivojlantirishi kerak.
example_ru: Современные учебные программы должны способствовать развитию критического мышления и самостоятельного поиска.
quiz_question_uz: IELTS Writing da «encourage the development of» (ijodkorlik yoki hamkorlikni rivojlantirmoq) o‘rniga qaysi C1 fe'l ishlatiladi?
quiz_question_ru: Какой глагол уровня C1 заменяет «encourage the development of» (культивировать инновации/сотрудничество)?
quiz_question_en: Which C1 verb upgrades "encourage the development of" (e.g., creativity or cooperation)?

definition_en: Upgrades vague 'a big change' into a sophisticated academic noun phrase suitable for describing social or economic trends.
basic_example_en: There has been a big change in how people shop.
example_en: There has been a profound shift in consumer purchasing habits over the past decade.
example_uz: So‘nggi o‘n yillikda iste'molchilarning xarid qilish odatlarida chuqur o‘zgarish yuz berdi.
example_ru: За последнее десятилетие произошёл глубокий сдвиг в покупательских привычках потребителей.
quiz_question_uz: IELTS insholarida oddiy «a big change» o‘rniga qaysi C1 akademik birikma qo‘llaniladi?
quiz_question_ru: Какое выражение уровня C1 лучше всего заменяет простое «a big change» в эссе IELTS?
quiz_question_en: Which C1 academic phrase upgrades the everyday expression "a big change"?

advanced_word: There is a widespread consensus that
translation_uz: Ko‘pchilik tomonidan e'tirof etilgan umumiy fikr mavjudki
translation_ru: Существует широкое согласие (консенсус) относительно того, что
definition_en: Upgrades informal 'most people agree that' into an impersonal, authoritative academic opening clause for IELTS Writing Task 2.
basic_example_en: Most people agree that early childhood education is essential.
example_en: There is a widespread consensus that early childhood education lays the foundation for lifelong success.
example_uz: Maktabgacha ta'lim umrbod muvaffaqiyat poydevorini qo‘yishi borasida keng tarqalgan hamfikrlik mavjud.
example_ru: Существует широкий консенсус в том, что дошкольное образование закладывает основу для успеха на всю жизнь.
quiz_question_uz: IELTS Writing Task 2 kirish qismida «Most people agree that» o‘rniga qaysi akademik qurilma ishlatiladi?
quiz_question_ru: Какая академическая конструкция заменяет «Most people agree that» во вступлении IELTS Writing Task 2?
quiz_question_en: Which formal clause upgrades "Most people agree that" in IELTS Writing Task 2 introductions?
options: There is a widespread consensus that

definition_en: Formal C1–C2 verb meaning to pacify or conciliate angry or dissatisfied people or critics.
basic_example_en: The company offered refunds to make angry customers less upset.
example_en: The airline offered full refunds and hotel vouchers to placate stranded passengers.
example_uz: Aviakompaniya aeroportda qolib ketgan yo‘lovchilarni tinchlantirish uchun to‘liq pul qaytarish va mehmonxona vaucherlarini taklif qildi.
example_ru: Авиакомпания предложила полный возврат средств и ваучеры на отель, чтобы успокоить застрявших пассажиров.
quiz_question_uz: Norozilik bildirayotgan odamlarni tinchlantirish ma'nosidagi rasmiy fe'lni tanlang:
quiz_question_ru: Какой формальный глагол означает «умиротворить, успокоить возмущённых людей»?
quiz_question_en: Which formal verb upgrades "make someone less angry or upset"?

definition_en: Formal C2 academic verb meaning to deliberately make information obscure or hard to understand.
basic_example_en: The company used technical terms to make the real risks unclear.
example_en: Critics accused the corporation of using technical jargon to obfuscate the real environmental risks.
example_uz: Tanqidchilar korporatsiyani haqiqiy ekologik xavflarni mavhumlashtirish uchun texnik atamalardan foydalanganlikda aybladilar.
example_ru: Критики обвинили корпорацию в использовании технического жаргона с целью запутать реальные экологические риски.
quiz_question_uz: Ma'lumotni ataylab murakkablashtirish va mavhumlashtirish qaysi C2 akademik fe'l bilan ifodalanadi?
quiz_question_ru: Какой академический глагол уровня C2 означает «намеренно запутывать, затемнять смысл»?
quiz_question_en: Which C2 academic verb means to deliberately render information obscure or confusing?

definition_en: Expressive idiomatic phrase ideal for IELTS Speaking Part 2 stories when describing quitting after a difficult struggle (avoid in formal Writing Task 2).
basic_example_en: After months of failed negotiations, the startup finally gave up.
example_en: After months of fruitless negotiations, the startup finally threw in the towel.
example_uz: Oylar davom etgan samarasiz muzokaralardan so‘ng startap nihoyat taslim bo‘ldi.
example_ru: После нескольких месяцев бесплодных переговоров стартап наконец сдался.
quiz_question_uz: IELTS Speaking da «Give up» (taslim bo‘lmoq) ma'nosini jonli ifodalovchi iborani tanlang:
quiz_question_ru: Выберите выражение для IELTS Speaking со значением «Give up» (сдаться, признать поражение):
quiz_question_en: Which expressive Speaking phrase best upgrades "give up" when admitting defeat?

definition_en: Strong C1–C2 collocation suitable for both IELTS Writing Task 2 and Speaking Part 3 when discussing civic or corporate duty.
basic_example_en: A good leader never avoids their duty when problems happen.
example_en: A true leader never shirks their responsibilities when a project faces setbacks.
example_uz: Haqiqiy rahbar loyiha qiyinchilikka uchraganda hech qachon o‘z mas'uliyatidan bo‘yin tovlamaydi.
example_ru: Настоящий лидер никогда не уклоняется от своих обязанностей, когда проект сталкивается с трудностями.
quiz_question_uz: «Vazifasidan yoki mas'uliyatidan bo‘yin tovlamoq» ma'nosini beruvchi C1–C2 collocation qaysi?
quiz_question_ru: Выберите коллокацию со значением «уклоняться от своих обязанностей»:
quiz_question_en: Which advanced collocation upgrades "avoid fulfilling one's duties"?

simple_word: Explain or form a part of
definition_en: Essential phrasal verb for IELTS Writing Task 1 (describing percentages/proportions) and Task 2 (explaining causes).
basic_example_en: Renewable energy forms 35% of the country's electricity.
example_en: Renewable sources now account for over 35% of the nation's electricity generation.
example_uz: Qayta tiklanuvchi manbalar hozirda mamlakat elektr energiyasi ishlab chiqarishining 35 foizdan ortig‘ini tashkil etadi.
example_ru: Возобновляемые источники сейчас составляют более 35% выработки электроэнергии в стране.
quiz_question_uz: IELTS Writing Task 1 da foiz yoki ulushni «tashkil etmoq» ma'nosida eng ko‘p ishlatiladigan phrasal verb qaysi?
quiz_question_ru: Какой фразовый глагол незаменим в IELTS Writing Task 1 в значении «составлять определённую долю/процент»?
quiz_question_en: Which essential phrasal verb means to form a particular proportion or percentage in IELTS Writing Task 1?

simple_word: Do what you promised or planned
translation_uz: Oxirigacha yetkazmoq, berilgan va'da yoki rejani amalda bajarmoq
translation_ru: Доводить до конца, выполнять (обещание или план)
definition_en: Natural C1 phrasal verb used in Speaking and Writing to emphasize completing a commitment rather than merely announcing it.
basic_example_en: Governments must do what they promised regarding climate goals.
example_en: Governments must follow through on their environmental pledges with concrete action.
example_uz: Hukumatlar ekologik va'dalarini aniq amaliy harakatlar bilan oxirigacha yetkazishlari shart.
example_ru: Правительства должны выполнять свои экологические обязательства конкретными действиями.
quiz_question_uz: Reja yoki va'dani yarim yo‘lda qoldirmay, amalda oxirigacha bajarish qaysi C1 phrasal verb bilan aytiladi?
quiz_question_ru: Какой фразовый глагол уровня C1 означает «довести начатое или обещанное до конца»?
quiz_question_en: Which C1 phrasal verb means to continue an action or pledge until it is fully completed?
